name: fincraft-tests

scripts.scan: node scan_dupes.mjs && node scan_handler_dupes.mjs && node scan_double_calls.mjs && node scan_unescaped_innerhtml.mjs
scripts.e2e:container: bash scripts/e2e/stack-up.sh && FINERACT_URL=https://127.0.0.1:8443 FINERACT_TENANT=default FINERACT_USER=mifos FINERACT_PASS=password playwright test; code=$?; bash scripts/e2e/stack-down.sh; exit $code

//devDependencies-note: eslint, globals, prettier and @playwright/test are optional tooling. They are intentionally NOT declared here so `npm ci` stays in sync with the committed package-lock.json (which is what tests.yml relies on). Install locally with: npm i -D eslint globals prettier @playwright/test && npx playwright install chromium. CI (quality.yml) installs them on demand.
